assessment.final_value: nimi li sike 90°. nimi wan wan la sitelen ona li awen wan.
assessment.backtranslation: Words rotate 90 degrees. For each word, its written characters remain together as one unit.
assessment.rationale: Accept the complete revision. nimi wan wan la scopes the continued unity to each individual word; sitelen ona refers to that word’s written characters. This resolves the original possibility of all separate words being merged into one. The first sentence retains actual 90-degree rotation. In SIDEWAYS, VerticalText accumulates joined sideways text and shapes a run before rotating it; this is not independent per-character rotation, unlike UPRIGHT. The value does not assert every glyph has a physical joining stroke, does not remove spaces, and does not change column order. No placeholders or linebreak escapes are added or removed.
assessment.provenance: Reviewer-authored original clarification independently reassessed by original author; no third-party sentence copied.
